verdict_msg: HARD_FAIL: the deflated codebook bulk edge FLUCTUATION is NOT TW-shaped (z-scored KS_p=0.0012; codebook-edge skew=-0.8934 vs synth-edge 0.3677, gap=1.2611 -- OPPOSITE/divergent skew direction, TW1 is right-skewed). ROOT CAUSE: the codebook spectrum has NO clean spike/bulk separation -- the top eigenvalues decay through a continuous heavy SHOULDER (not k isolated spikes above an MP bulk), so adaptive-k is unstable (mean k_deflated=19.82 vs intrinsic 15) and 'the deflated bulk edge' is not well-defined at M=253. 9d pillar dim-5 (TW edge on deflated bulk) is NOT supported at current corpus size; the codebook is not in the spikes+RMT-bulk regime the pillar assumed. NOTE: a low-power z-scored KS_p (here 0.0012) can falsely pass -- the skew-sign disagreement is the decisive shape discriminator. PROTOCOL REFRAME (pending Research endorsement): two questions are separated. (Q1 LOCATION) is the deflated bulk an iid-MP bulk? matched-edge KS_p=0.0000, mean-gap=8.6329 -> iid-MP=False. Parent Cell C found the bulk is SUB-FREE-POISSON (structured), so a location gap is EXPECTED and is NOT the dim-5 question. (Q2 SHAPE = the actual dim-5 / Tracy-Widom question) after centering+scaling, is the edge FLUCTUATION shape TW-universal? z-scored KS_p=0.0012, codebook-edge skew=-0.8934 (synth-edge 0.3677, asymptotic TW1 0.2935). Tooling null (synth-vs-synth) KS_p=0.4006. Convergence (n=126) shape KS_p=0.0000 -> size_robust=False. WHY the original absolute-TW1 gate was dropped: an ideal iid Wishart at M=253 sits at mean(W)=-1.1894 (not -1.2065); the asymptotic gate is unmeetable at this corpus size (finite-size, Ma 2012). k_full=15 spikes; mean k_deflated=19.82.
